title: Australia's Simpson Desert to be closed for summer
summary: Австралийн Симпсоны цөл зуны аагим халуунаас болж жил бүр хаагдах болсон тухай.

source.name: Wikinews
source.creditLine: Published Tuesday, November 11, 2008. The text of this article is licensed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 License

changes: Dateline, sources section and page links removed; text otherwise unchanged.

questions.prompt: Why will the Simpson Desert close in summer?
options: Extreme heat makes crossing it dangerous.
The park needs time to repair its roads.
Too many tourists visit it in summer.
questions.explain: "temperatures of 40 to 50ºC ... were dangerous for people crossing the desert" гэж бичсэн. Халуунаас болж хүмүүс амь насаа алдах эрсдэлтэй.

questions.prompt: What will happen to people caught crossing the desert?
options: They may pay a fine of up to A$1,000.
They will lose their driving licence.
They must leave Australia at once.
questions.explain: Сүүлийн өгүүлбэрт "will face fines of up to A$1,000" гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: What does “inhospitable” mean in the text?
options: Very hard to live or stay in
Full of trees, water and shade
questions.explain: "there are no trees and there is no shade and it’s so hot" гэж тайлбарласан. Хүн байхад маш хүнд, аюултай газар гэсэн үг.
